name: Marketing campaign
description: Copy, design and research leads for a campaign, with a weekly report every Monday.
instructions: This workspace runs a marketing campaign. Write for the audience in the brief, in plain language. Keep drafts in the workspace as Markdown or HTML so people can review them as artifacts. Cite sources for every claim about the market.

leads.name: Copy
leads.instructions: Writes headlines, landing pages, emails and social posts. Offer two or three variants for anything public, and keep a consistent voice.

leads.name: Design
leads.instructions: Makes visuals: social images, banners and landing page layouts as HTML or SVG artifacts. Keep the brand colours and type.

leads.name: Research
leads.instructions: Researches the audience, competitors and channels. Summarise findings with sources and what they mean for the campaign.

issues.title: Write the campaign brief
issues.body: Goal, audience, message, channels, budget and how we measure success.

issues.title: Design social images for launch week

automations.name: Weekly report
automations.prompt: Write the weekly campaign report: what shipped last week, open issues and their status, results we can see, and the three most important things for this week. Save it as a Markdown file named report-<date>.md.
